_what: ServerNetworkHandler::_processValidatedLoginPacket - the call at 0x8cc3326 that copy-constructs the PlayerAuthenticationInfo (helper 0x74077f0) which BDS then hands to _createNewPlayer, before player storage is selected. In 1.26.60.6 Mojang merged the old _validateLoginPacket into this path; _processValidatedLoginPacket survives from 1.26.51.1 with an instruction-identical head (memcpy 0xAC auth struct, cmpb [r12+0x60], auth copy ctor), so the PlayerAuthenticationInfo layout is unchanged. The site is the copy constructor, so the hook reads the object it built at the caller-passed destination (rdi), a plain PlayerAuthenticationInfo with no engaged flag.
_register_contract: rbx = PlayerAuthenticationInfo& (source of the copy, rsi at the call site), r12 = optional<MessToken>&, rbp = this (ServerNetworkHandler), r13 = NetworkIdentifier, r14 = shared_ptr<LoginPacket>.
